lines.en: I sway, and the bell rings.
Like a pendulum, I swing side to side.
My brass feet click on the stone.
Every step leaves an aftertone.

lines.zh: 我在炼金台上被铸出来。
lines.en: I was cast on an alchemy bench.
The clapper knocks softly inside.
I roll a stretch of the way.
My body tips, then rights itself.
The sound arrives first; I arrive late.
One ding, scattered into the air.
I hang and sway gently.
The aftertone still turns in the air.
I am a bell that walks.
Something moves inside the brass.
I wait for someone to touch me.
The patterns are finely engraved.
I do not need to eat.
Underwater my voice is duller.
I turn my mouth to a new bearing.
My shadow shows on the flagstones.
My mouth tilts slightly downward.
It is very quiet, and I do not like it.
The wind passes, and I ring.
I am waiting for one strike.
My surface has begun to oxidise.
I sway once, without moving.
You heard my voice.
I turn my whole bell toward you.
Do you want to strike me once?
You have iron in your hand.
If I am struck, I return it.
One step more and you are in my mouth.
The ring scatters at your ear.
I am no ordinary bell.
I know your footsteps now.
You shifted half a step back.
My brass shows your face.
I ring once by way of answer.
The blow sets me ringing wildly.
The aftertone has turned to noise.
A dent appears in my brass.
I swung a long while before settling.
Anger makes me ring faster.
That knock leaves my bronze dull.
My clapper is askew.
I am still standing.
Struck means I strike back.
Brass does not bleed.
I only want to hear one impact.
Hold it as long as you like; I will not move.
A bell does not get hungry.
I would rather hear a collision.
Food cannot ring my bell.
That will not attract brass.
I tilt my mouth.
Bring something else.
I only react to sound.
Knock on me; that works.
I strike, and the bell sounds.
You bounce off my brass shell.
We knock out a string of aftertones.
My body is swaying hard.
My bronze body spins before it rights itself.
You heard that one too, did you not?
I right my bell body.
A scratch is added to my brass.
You knocked my ring into disorder.
Strike again and I ring again.
Another bell is here too.
We sway at the same time.
Two notes, folded together.

lines.zh: 炼金造物之间，无需言语。
lines.en: Alchemical things need no words.
I hear your aftertone.
Our rhythm has aligned.
We roll across the flagstones together.
Brass and brass will resonate.
This sound travels far.
Sway once more.
I draw it up into my mouth.
The clapper touches it once.
This is too small.
It rolls around inside me.
I sway once and it is gone.
This is not worth keeping.
I tip it back out.
It lies heavy in hand.
It makes a sound inside me.
I tuck it inside the bell.
A sound, over there.
My whole bell turns toward it.
The clapper moved on its own.
You have entered my range.
If struck, I always strike back.
I am ready to roll.
My brass starts to vibrate.
Right here on these flagstones.
The clapper is already aligned.
Sound does not lie to me.
You are still in this corridor.
I am counting the beat of those steps.
My mouth points at you.
The bell has begun.
I am rolling over.

lines.zh: 余音还没散，我已经滚了。
lines.en: Before the echo fades, I am already rolling.
This range will do.
I have set my stance.
I keep heading for the sound.
Your steps shake the flagstones.
I roll slowly, but accurately.
Your footsteps are heavy.
I circle closer.
Each ring brings me nearer.
Your feet have stopped.
I can hunt without eyes.
My brass against the ground feels the tremors.
You are behind the wall.
I heard you breathe.
The aftertone grows brighter.
You have backed into the corner.
My mouth is aimed at you.
This one will connect.
Can you get away?

lines.zh: 你胸腔的震动我数得清。
lines.en: I can count the tremors in your chest.
Just before the ding.
The bell body is shaking.
I will not let you go.
I slam my whole body in.
One great ring, and you stagger back.
My brass rim scrapes your arm.
The sound wave shoves you back.
I roll over your feet.
The clapper springs out and back.
That one lacked weight.
I steady my bell.
You blocked it.
I strike once more.
The echo lingers; I have already moved.
What you held went flying.
I am swaying fiercely.
That blow rang for a long time.
A light ring, and I appear.
I have been set down here.
My brass rings first, then settles.
A new aftertone in the air.
I have come down off the alchemy bench.
Mouth down, I turn slowly.
The flagstone shuddered once.
Someone called me out.
My voice is clear.
I sway, then hold.
My brass mirrors the light around.
I am here for one strike.
Soon you will hear me.
My bronze turns and the echo spills out.
There is an echo in this place.
I will sound once first.
I rang once.
I hang here.
My body rises and falls.
Listen well.

lines.zh: 火烤得我发烫，音也变了。
lines.en: Fire heats me, and my note changes.
The flagstone cracks under my fall.
In the water my voice is muffled.
The blast drowns out my ring.
Something struck my flank.
This force makes the brass shiver.
I do not eat, yet I can weaken.
Thunder and I rang out together.
There is no echo here.
